newsitem.title: CANADA: Tor-Dom sees C$170 mln 1996 loan losses.
newsitem.headline: Tor-Dom sees C$170 mln 1996 loan losses.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Thursday its third-quarter estimate for 1996 loan losses was C$170 million, unchanged from the second quarter.
"One quarter of this estimate, or C$43 million, was charged against income in the quarter," the bank said.
Toronto-Dominion said net impaired loans rose by C$44 million in the third quarter ending July 31, largely due to business loans to borrowers in Canada.
Net impaired loans as a percentage of total loans and bankers' acceptances at 0.5 percent were unchanged from the second quarter.
